title: FormLogic Flows event binding
description: The JSON configuration of one row in app_flow_bindings (columns condition_json, input_map_json, output_actions_json, retry_policy_json, fallback_policy_json map to the fields below). Binds an app/form/connector event to a flow. Canonical copy: formlogic-app/docs/contracts/.

event.description: Event name that triggers the flow. Desktop/connector events ("aokie.call.ended"), form events ("form.submitted"), or "manual".

flow.description: flow_definitions.slug within the same app scope.

mode.description: sync: caller waits (live-call decisions/UI actions only, enforce small timeoutMs). async: queue and continue. background: fire-and-log. manual: user-triggered button.

expr.description: Sandboxed boolean expression over {event}. Evaluated in the QuickJS sandbox, never eval().

inputMap.description: Flow input name -> source selector ($event.data, $event.data.callerPhone, $app, literal values).

type.description: MVP action set. Every formlogic.* write goes through the normal authenticated submission/update API so server-side validation, permissions and onSubmit scripts still run. 'formlogic.store' persists part of the result into Flow KV (docs §9); it requires the flow to declare the 'formlogic.kv.write' capability.

value.description: formlogic.store: selector into $result or a literal to persist.

fallbackReply.description: For sync live-call bindings: spoken/UI fallback when the flow times out or fails.
